title: Sony Pictures might pick up a movie adaptation of Battlefield, starring Michael B. Jordan.
summary: Revisiting rumors from earlier this year, Deadline and TheWrap report the adaptation of EA’s long-running FPS series would be directed and written by frequent Tom Cruise collaborator Christopher McQuarrie. Discovery, Amazon MGM Studios, Universal, and Netflix.
